## How engagements are shaped

There are two distinct routes, and they are deliberately kept separate:

- **A business with an operational problem.** Diagnose a bounded problem, scope
  an implementation, deliver it with a team behind it. Ongoing technical support
  follows where it makes sense rather than by default.
- **A team that needs one specialist.** Direct contracting for a single
  contribution: an architecture decision, an assessment, an integration design,
  or technical delivery leadership on an existing programme. A prospect does not
  have to buy an entire agency to get one architect.

Healthcare and EMR **product** enquiries are handled by 3 Stripes Technologies
(https://www.3stripestech.com), not through this site.

## What he does

- **Cloud architecture on Azure.** Infrastructure design, migration, identity,
  networking, security and cost optimisation. 20+ Microsoft Solution Assessments
  delivered.
- **Automation and integration.** Connecting systems a business already runs so
  data stops being re-entered by hand. Centralise the data into one source of
  truth first, then automate the process over it. Azure, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB,
  n8n.
- **Technical delivery.** Scoping, architecture and delivery leadership for
  builds that have to survive handover, including custom portals, full-stack
  applications and the deployment pipeline underneath them.
- **Microsoft 365 and identity.** Tenant configuration, identity federation,
  endpoint management and licensing structures sized to the organisation.
- **Copilot readiness and adoption.** Readiness assessment and adoption
  workshops. A separate practice from the automation work, with its own proof.

## Named frameworks

- **The Caribbean Cloud Readiness Framework.** A structured assessment of whether
  a regional business is ready to move to Azure: infrastructure, security
  posture, cost modelling, migration sequencing.
- **Adoption Over Access.** Access to AI tools is easy; adoption is the work.
  Training and change management over licensing.
- **The ARC Delivery Model.** Embedded rather than transactional. Sub-principle:
  centralise first, automate second.
- **Good Chefs Saute Evenly.** The four-ingredient Copilot prompt framework:
  Goal, Context, Source, Expectation. Taught across 95 workshops.

## Case studies

Status language is used precisely. "Live in production" means a system in real
daily use. Work that is built and deployed but still inside a client review gate
is described that way. Figures attributed to a client are client-reported rather
than independently measured.

- [Enterprise Apps Masterview](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/esvd-dashboard/):
  internal operations portal replacing Azure Portal browsing, spreadsheet cost
  tracking, expense email chains and the Toggl UI. 4 production apps across 2
  Azure subscriptions, 5 roles enforced server-side on every authenticated
  endpoint alongside a small set of deliberately public intake and tracking
  routes. Engineering detail worth noting: atomic ETag-conditioned campaign-send
  claiming, timestamp guards on specific automation trigger paths, closed-period
  enforcement on finance writes, and 31 test suites. Live in production.
- [SASSI Logistics Platform](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/sassi/):
  a package-forwarding business moved off WhatsApp and spreadsheets onto a
  full-stack Azure platform. Client portal, admin and warehouse dashboards,
  AI-assisted support ticketing. User base reported by the client at 200+.
  Live in production; later feature work runs through a separate client approval
  gate.
- [3 Stripes Tech EMR](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/3-stripes-tech/):
  a cloud-based EMR built for Caribbean healthcare providers. Co-founded and
  architected the V3 rebuild. Measured during that rollout: server-driven
  pagination took a core workflow from 5-10 seconds to under one, and adding a
  WAF layer dropped sustained CPU from 80-100% to 30-40%. Live in production.
- [QT Digital, Qualitech](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/qualitech/):
  seven isolated spreadsheets consolidated behind one Azure PostgreSQL source of
  truth. Workflow automation is delivered and running, including quotation
  handling, scheduled follow-up and an AI voice calling agent. The department
  portal is built and deployed but currently inside the client review gate, not
  an accepted production rollout.
- [3 Stripes Tech product site](https://www.3stripestech.com): public product and
  marketing site, Next.js 15 and React 19, with a technical SEO, accessibility
  and structured-data pass. Live in production.
- [Wiman](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/wiman-dlp/): SAML 2.0 identity
  federation, Intune endpoint management, Microsoft 365 licensing architecture.
  Delivered as a bounded engagement.
- [The Jimny Shop](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/jimny-shop/):
  WooCommerce storefront and digital infrastructure for a Suzuki Jimny
  specialist. Live in production.
- [ARC Cloud Portfolio](https://www.antoniocumberbatch.com/work/arc-portfolio/):
  this site. Azure Blob Storage origin, Front Door CDN, Azure Functions, Cosmos
  DB, GitHub Actions. Live in production.
- Road to 190 workout app: a local prototype used as a build-in-public example.
  Not a released product, no backend and no hosting.

## Claims this site does not make

Stated explicitly because these are the things most likely to be inferred
incorrectly:

- No market-primacy claim. The EMR is described as built for Caribbean
  healthcare providers, not as the region's first.
- No blanket endpoint-authentication claim. Authorisation is enforced on every
  authenticated endpoint; public intake, tracking and unsubscribe routes are open
  by design.
- No duplicate-create guarantee. The campaign-send claim is atomic; the contact
  lookup is not, so no exactly-once creation guarantee is claimed.
- No current latency or response-time figure. Historical performance numbers are
  attributed to when they were measured.
- No search ranking, traffic or revenue claim.
- No private commercial terms, client financial details or patient data.
